findings: The quality output body requires the complete frozen campaign/numerical/input gate, one exact conditional request option for its slot, a bound frozen projection and the family/rank checkpoint allowance. It composes bounded training, raw/H200 export and full validation under the separate7200s/4GiB RSS/6GiB MPS-driver/8GiB reserve recorder.

An immutable attempt and terminal producer record bind request, plan, training outputs, evaluation provenance and completed resources. Any phase failure remains permanent; no next stage, cleanup, retry or adoption is performed. Saved LR/rank selection and complete current/future storage remain mandatory parent controller gates.

The new read-only quality stage wrapper requires every selected and losing producer record in addition to existing numerical, metadata, tensor-value, resource, process, selection and inventory checks. It enforces canonical slot paths, unique raw/H200 inodes and actual corpus hash, and binds original training/export sizes and hashes, metrics, evaluation input files, training-token digest and descriptive sample settings.

The shared producer binder retains its default pilot contract. Combined tests cover pilot dispatch/boundary regressions, quality output/audit compatibility, failure preservation, request/projection tampering, missing winner provenance and changed corpus/weights. Quality body fixtures cover slots0,9,15,23 spanning LR/rank/fresh stages; they use tiny synthetic tensors and mocked scientific phases.
limitations: Scientific training, validation, frozen numerical gating and MPS resource observations are mocked in quality composition fixtures. The bounded writers, recorder lifecycle, producer binding and audit rejection logic execute for real on disposable fixtures. This is not real model-quality, nine-case numerical, MPS cache or measured-pilot evidence.
No CLI or real trial was launched, no research checkpoint was deleted, no closed controller or failed combined numerical fixture was rerun, and the holdout remains closed.

Quality startup/selection-aware dispatch, bounded independent tensor-audit production, LR/rank cleanup and inference orchestration still require integration. Fresh confirmation stage acceptance is not implemented by the LR/rank wrapper. Actual nine numerical/input and measured-pilot prerequisites remain unresolved; the27-trajectory campaign remains unfrozen.
